name: 08-earl-grey-tea-and-chasen
prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: 128am Cafe polished photorealistic product catalog portrait, 3:4 (1086x1448). Edit input image 1, the approved CLEAN product and typography master: change only scene and lighting as requested below, preserving the exact drink packaging, product recipe appearance and typography system. One single image, no collage.
PRODUCT INVARIANTS: one actual squat clear plastic sundae cup with rounded bottom and clean transparent dome lid, front-facing mascot sticker identical to reference including brown-haired girl with pink bow/apron, white bunny with exactly TWO ears, 128am CAFE label. Natural green matcha above beige infused milk, small low white cold-foam folds lightly dusted with matcha INSIDE the cup, beneath dome, no tall whipped cream tower. At very bottom retain clearly visible THIN amber-brown Earl Grey syrup layer, only about 4–5% of total liquid height, matching the master. Not thick chocolate syrup.
CLEANLINESS CRITICAL: outside of cup, dome, and the whole projecting snap-on rim/flange absolutely clear and CLEAN, with NO spilled green foam, no overflow, no green paste along the exterior flange, no exterior drips or smears. Foam stays contained INSIDE below the clean rim. Realistic tiny clear condensation droplets allowed on cup body only. Full cup, dome, rim and base visible with generous margins.
TYPOGRAPHY: exact same master bold rounded Fredoka-style dark rose #B8496C lowercase headline, two lines exactly 'earl grey' then 'matcha latte'. Beneath it small cocoa line exactly '128am Cafe', consistent letter-spaced styling of master. Centered title at top, safe margins at least 7%, highly legible. No price, claims or extra copy.
STYLE: true commercial product photograph, appetising natural daylight, convincing transparent plastic, natural food colours, clean cream #FFF8F5 / blush #FDE5EB / sage #E7F0DC brand palette, softly dimensional lighting. No drawing, no CGI, no new packaging, straw, imaginary topping, garnish on drink or watermark.
SCENE: Tea and chasen still life. Full front-facing cup centered on warm cream tabletop, behind at left a small simple ceramic dish of loose dry Earl Grey tea leaves, behind at right a bamboo chasen whisk. Props subtle and softly out of focus, drink remains hero, morning daylight, no ingredients on outside of cup and no additions to drink.
visual_qa: Passed: text, cup and logo, two-ear bunny, thin amber syrup layer, clear exterior rim, distinct scene.
